releases.displayName: The second Performance Patch for These Sunny Daze is arrived!

items.text: It’s December, baby!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/3765ee9a6672329a66f72286d000373e67ed2d9b.png"]
Massive thanks to all of you guys for your engagement, patience, and for pointing out every little thing that felt off. You’re irreplaceable. Seriously <3.
Things should run smoother pretty much everywhere now, but you’ll especially feel the difference on Map 3, which got the most work-smooth-or-die love this time around.
➡ Check out a small FPS comparison!

And if your trusty rig is closer to the minimum specs: no worries. We didn’t forget about you dude. Besides optimization, we also fixed a bunch of bugs you reported along the way. Full patch notes are right below:
Fixed an issue where players were unable to access the Credits menu using a controller.
Fixed weird interactions when remapping weapon wheel keybindings
Fixed multiple visual issues related to textures and LODs.
Fixes to different glass elements in base game
Fixed issue where saving at a checkpoint would freeze the game for a few seconds
Fixed missing “POSTAL: Brain Damaged” text in the Credits section when using Brazilian Portuguese.
Fixed a soft-lock caused by opening the Weapon Wheel and Pause Menu at the same time.
Fixed an issue where some enemy melee attacks could deal damage through Nyanbrella’s shield.
Fixed multiple map gaps and tight spaces where the player could get permanently stuck.
Fixes to UrAnusium Syringe zoom
Optimized the way enemies on the levels are spawned
Improvements of culling range
Introduced static batching
Fixed Xwitch Thot melee attack going through block
Fix to possibly getting stuck at the start of DLC Boss Fight
Fixed multiple LOD issues affecting background assets, especially around the C.A.T.E. base.
Fixed an issue where some enemies would fail to spawn in certain areas.
Fixed an issue where the UrAnusium Syringe poster could sometimes not be picked up.
Improvements to lighting and mesh optimization
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png"]

releases.displayName: P:TSD Content Update & Small Performance Fixes Incoming!

notes.title: New things, better things, and bunch of fixed things.

items.text: It may have seemed quiet, but behind the scenes we’ve been neck-deep in These Sunny Daze DLC's guts, tracing bottlenecks, unclogging blockages and putting together a plan to get things flowing right.

notes.title: This update brings only the small, first wave of improvements

items.text: a starter patch that kicks off a two-part plan to boost performance.: The next one is already in the works. And while we were down there, we just couldn’t resist sneaking in some new stuff too.
New tropical arena map available in Survival Mode (for P:TSD owners only)
Brand-new alt-fire for UrAnisum Syringe (let’s just say it’s not exactly subtle)
The sewers in Erection Day have been rebuilt and improved, based on a blueprint straight from your feedback. New routes, same stench. Go see how it flows now!
And speaking of the flow...
This update is the first, smaller part of a two-stage process of improving P:TSD’s performance.
It’s taking time, we know, but we didn’t want to just slap duct tape on the surface. We chose to dig deeper, hunt down the actual causes and fix things at its source.
Some areas are already running a lot smoother, so instead of making you wait for the whole thing,
we’re dropping a small batch of fixes today.
We know this isn’t the whole deal. Right now we’re going after the rougher spots and making sure things run better on lower-end rigs too.
You can expect the second patch to drop before the end of December!
New Survival Mode map (DLC owners only)
Changes to Sniper Rifle - Alt-fire fires mini-nukes
Overhaul of the Erection Day in Sewers
Moto Mama now speaks - she’s got her own voice lines!
Fixed an issue where the "B**ch Lore" achievement could be unlocked despite not owning These Sunny Daze
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to select levels in Survival Mode with a controller
Fixed some cases in which certain enemies would not be affected by fire and confusion piss
Fixed an issue where Big Bad Rona's eyes were not damaged by the BFG's lightning
STEAM ONLY: Fixed an issue where the "Play Mods" option in the Mods menu would not function correctly
Fixed an issue where the 'PTSD' achievement would not unlock if cutscenes were disabled in the settings
Adjusted the collider of the Bubblegun's alternate projectile to more closely match its visuals
Fixed an issue where not all new enemies would use navmesh links
Fixed an issue where using the Sticky Hand on anal plugs would play the sound effect twice
Picking up a sausage from Wiener Grinder now makes the proper food eating sound
Fixed an issue where on Steam Deck, ice would not be displayed properly in the cold storage room
Fixed an issue where some cars lacked collision
Fixed an issue that caused CATE Agents to occasionally float in the air
Fixed an issue where the altar at the top of the stairs floated in the air
The crowd in the starting area now has audio
Minor adjustments to the lighting in the Whitest House

notes.title: Also there’s two new game localizations - Hungarian and Brazilian Portuguese!

items.text: We know it’s not everything yet - but we’re still grinding to make everything run smoother and nastier.
Let us know if the ride’s less bumpy and the new content hits the right spots.
The second update's already on the way, and we’ll drop it as soon as it’s cooked!

releases.displayName: Update on recent Unity security vulnerability!

items.text: Due to a recently disclosed security vulnerability found in some Unity-built games, we wanted to let you know that we’ve already taken care of it on our side.

There’s no indication that the issue was ever exploited or that anyone was affected, but fixes have already been released - and we applied them right away to ensure that POSTAL: Brain Damaged are now fully patched and secure.

You don’t need to do anything on your side - just keep your game updated as usual. We’ll continue to monitor the situation and follow the latest security recommendations to keep everything running safe and sound.
Stay safe!
Hyperstrange out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/837feb3f28a9199565f25131081dd9a6a06b4fa0.png"]

releases.displayName: These Sunny Daze DLC Weapons Balance Patch!

items.text: Hey dudes!
You yelled, we listened - the new update cranks up the weapons, not just tweaking the numbers but also their special features!
This is just the first round of tweaks, so jump in, see how the guns feel now, and tell us what you think in this thread.
We’ll keep tuning them until they hit just right!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685888/d6044b8ff0d0ef9d82b76f3230aae7ec4d17aeb1.jpg"]
Bugs screamed. Code cried. The patch didn’t care.
Everything acting up got dragged out back and “retired” permanently.
We nuked the nastiest bugs, smacked the keybinds until they learned some manners, and even the elevators got taught a lesson.

notes.title: Here’s what we hammered into shape this time

items.text: Fixed custom keybinds not saving properly. There’s one final reset with this patch, but once you set them again, they’ll stick for good.
Cleaned up tons of small map issues, including clipping, textures, and other minor cases.
Achievements that were unlocking incorrectly should now work as intended.
Falling into the kill plane will no longer respawn you at the wrong location.
Fixed a bug where Balloonmen could spontaneously explode a few seconds after loading a save.
The fuse box on the first DLC level should now work properly for everyone.
We’ve adjusted saving on the first level: you can still save before or after the elevator ride, but not while it’s moving - turns out the elevator refuses to cooperate mid-journey.

Stay cool, sip your drinks, enjoy the last days of summer… 'cause October’s forecast has Hurricane Dude on the radar, bringing a rain of update heavy enough to drown the maps like a clogged motel bathroom.
Added gamepad assist and addressed some minor bugs.
Fixed issue with uploading map without a screenshot thumbnail; now maps should upload correctly even if the user didn't set a thumbnail.
Fixed several issues with displaying text within GUI across different language versions in Map Editor

releases.displayName: OST update incoming! Check out the new PBD Music Video

items.text: We know you're old enough to remember when MTV used to play music video clips. Well... some of you are. We kind of miss those times and we need to fill that void in our hearts. Therefore - here's our newest endeavor - a DEDICATED HYPERSTRANGE GAME MUSIC VIDEO CHANNEL on YouTube! You should go and subscribe to it THIS INSTANT, as there's already something POSTAL-y and exciting out there for you, and that's only just the tip... of the iceberg of explosive music content that's headed there.
Back already? OK, we could've saved you a click, but chose not to. Here's the video:

You did subscribe, didn't you? Well, you should. Because on December 13 the POSTAL: Brain Damaged OST is getting a MAJOR update. All the tracks have been remastered and a couple of all-new bangers joins the line-up (this will make the perfect 69-minute running time longer :sadface:). And all this will end up on the HYPERSTRANGE GAME MUSIC CHANNEL on the release day, available free for everyone to enjoy.

Subscribed? Those few of you who still didn't should know that OUR NEW YOUTUBE CHANNEL will also feature official OST uploads from other Hyperstrange games. Does this means that we're not releasing our stuff through streaming services? No sir! That's coming too. When? Hah. That's complicated. But it looks like December 2022 (yes! This current month!) is still on the table. We'll keep you posted... so...
Subscribe?
Your's truly,

releases.displayName: FREE Horde Mode content update for the 25th POSTAL Series Anniversary

items.text: POSTAL: Brain Damaged is a new, action-oriented take on the Running With Scissors’ cult game series with throwback graphics, and fast-paced, modern gameplay. Take a wild roller coaster ride through the twisted wonderland encased in the POSTAL DUDE’S messed-up mind. And now... it comes with a HORDE MODE!

Rip & Turd your way through endless waves of assholes flooding three special gangba... skirmish arenas. Put all of the iconic Brain Damaged arsenal to use and choose your options wisely wave after wave. That's right! Your all-time favorite POSTAL frenchise spin-off got itself a fully-fledged score-attack horde mode. Get ready to bring in the pain... or suffer!
Enjoy this FREE additional content brought to you by the mad lads at Hyperstrange just in time for the POSTAL Series 25th Anniversary Celebration!
Yes, a celebration. In the world of peddling video games it usually means: "get the games cheaper than usual", and this time it's no different. ALL of the POSTAL games are on promo. Go get!
Remember to tell us how you enjoy the new content and how damn hard and unfair it is!

releases.displayName: POSTAL: Brain Damaged update, Blood West Chapter 2, Supplice release date, INCIS

items.text: It is that time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

notes.title: INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers!

items.text: Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement

items.text: POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude!

Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: 30 march 2023!

notes.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement

items.text: And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!
As we all know, POSTAL: Brain Damaged is PERFECT, but we are Hyperstrange, so - naturally - we want to make it PERFECTER. So here's our first POST-release patch. But first, a POSTAL-babe!
YEAH! Feast your eyes on that beauty, before the beauty feasts on your eyes! You're gonna need them to read...
Fixed second boss saving issues
Fixed end boss saving issues
Quicksaves are saved on disk upon saving, instead of when quitting the game
Cutscenes force vsync for their duration, should fix screen tearing
Final boss overlapping audio fixed
Added "-novideo" launch option, might help with game crashing in certain instances
The prison showers in "Bareback redemption" shouldn't block progress now
Suburbia leaderboard exploit fixed
Sniffing in the vip zone aquarium breaking blocker fixed
Sniffing in the vip zone blue key killplane added
Fixed quick pills effect persisting through scene changes
Ragdoll and physical object saving should not cause performance issues anymore
Penterator moaning can be adjusted in audio settings now
ammo capacity increased for all weapons, should make ammo management easier for now. The issue will be addressed properly in the balancing update
ambient stopping aftewr player death fixed
fixed leocalisation of move left and move right in control settings
achievement description fixed (GYMCEL, TAKE THE BLUE PILL, DOUBLE THE EXCITEMENT)
added default controller template for steam
fixed weapon wheel time slowdown persisting between scenes
fixed kill plane/reset level exploit
combat music condition checking fixed, should be way more consistent now
added optional dynamic combat music, you can set number of hostiles that trigger combat music in audio settings (0 disables dynamic combat music)
all beam attacks have their audio moved to end point, you can actually hear the beams now
Unity engine version updated
Yeah, beam enemies should *feel* more fair now. Stop crying. As said before, today's update is only the first one ahead in the imminent future. Here's the summary of things to expect:
Post-release fix - an update taking care of the known issues reported by the players, that slipped into the full release

Balancing update - some players, as well as some internet micro-celebrities, have brought to our attention that the game offers way to much ammo if you explore the levels 'Quake-style', and far too little if you prefer to push on 'Doom Eternal-style'. The update will take care of that issue, allowing everyone to enjoy the game in their preferred playstyle. The update will also reconfigure some of the enemy positioning, spawns, and behavior. (ETA: One month)

New playmodes - With that taken care of, the dev team will proceed to expanding the game itself, introducing an oft-requested horde mode, as well as another playmode offering a new, and replayable PBD experience. (ETA: This summer)
More to be announced!
Are we done for today? Nope! There's one more thing. We really want you to follow Hyperstrange Twitter and join Hyperstrange Discord. Why? So you don't miss out on fun stuff, such as...

Damn. You missed the submission deadline. Should've listened and followed that Hyperstrange Twitter and joined Hyperstrange Discord. There were some very nice prizes, too! But hey, you're right on time too see some GREAT fan art by some of the winners:
